gloss: to be buried; to be hidden; to be lost among

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {埋|うず}もれていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to be buried; to be covered; to be snowed under
definitions.explanation: To be physically buried or covered by something piled on top — snow, sand, rubble, objects, etc.

definitions.gloss: to be hidden; to be lost among; to go unnoticed
definitions.explanation: To be obscured or overlooked among many other things, or to live in obscurity without recognition.

examples.english: The house was buried in snow.

notes:
Intransitive ichidan verb. Takes the particle ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ to indicate what something is buried in or under. Very common both literally (buried in snow, rubble) and figuratively (talent going unnoticed, information being lost).

TRANSITIVITY:
- {埋|うず}もれる (intransitive): to be buried, to be hidden
- ⟦{埋|う}める→埋める：01901_umeru⟧ (transitive): to bury, to fill in

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{埋|うず}もれる: to be buried in snow
- ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{埋|うず}もれる: to be buried under paperwork
- ⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{埋|うず}もれる: for talent to go unrecognized
- ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{埋|うず}もれる: to be lost to history

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{埋|う}まる→埋まる：01897_umaru⟧: to be buried — similar meaning, but {埋|うず}もれる emphasizes being completely covered or hidden
- ⟦{隠|かく}れる→隠れる：02035_kakureru⟧: to hide — active hiding; {埋|うず}もれる implies passive concealment
